FX-KEY-001.says: The screen's green chosen, tolerance 0: the screen goes, its half-covering right edge too; the shadow, the spill and the figure stay.

FX-KEY-002.says: Tolerance 80: the shadow, 77 from the green on its green channel, goes too; the spill, 90 from it on its red, stays.

FX-KEY-003.says: Tolerance 60, softness 40: the shadow, 17 into the band, keeps 17/40 of its colour and covering, and the spill, 30 into it, keeps 30/40; the figure, far past the band, stays whole.

FX-KEY-004.says: Match hue, tolerance 10: the shadow, the same hue as the screen, goes with it; the spill, 13 degrees of hue away (18.6 of 255), stays, and so does the figure and its grey button.

FX-KEY-005.says: Match hue, tolerance 10, softness 20: the spill keeps (18.6 - 10) / 20 of itself.

FX-KEY-006.says: No colour chosen: the drawing, untouched.

FX-KEY-007.says: No colour chosen, match hue, tolerance 255: the drawing, untouched.

FX-KEY-008.says: Tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frames 0 and 2, tolerance 0 and 50, are FX-KEY-001; frame 4, tolerance 100, takes the shadow and the spill too.

FX-KEY-009.says: Tolerance 60, softness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: frame 0 keeps the shadow and the spill whole; frame 4 keeps 17/100 of the shadow and 30/100 of the spill, and the band now reaches the line, 151 from the green, which keeps 91/100, and the button, 128 from it, 68/100.

FX-KEY-010.says: The green and the skin chosen: the screen and the figure's skin go; the line, the button, the spill and the shadow stay.

FX-KEY-011.says: FX-KEY-001 with the colour written in capitals: the same.

FX-KEY-012.says: The grey chosen, match rgb: only the button goes.

FX-KEY-013.says: The grey chosen, match hue, tolerance 254: a grey is 255 from everything, so nothing goes.

FX-KEY-014.says: The grey chosen, match hue, tolerance 255: everything is within 255, so the frame is empty.

FX-KEY-015.says: FX-KEY-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-KEY-016.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-017.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-018.says: Softness 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-019.says: Softness keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-020.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-021.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-022.says: Match "hsv", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KEY-023.says: Match "RGB", in capitals, which is kept as written and is not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
